title: 4A Full Adhesive Sticky Notes, 3 x 5 Inches, 5 Assorted Colors, 5 Pads, 20 Sheets per Pad, 100 Sheets Total
bullets: 5 pads, 100 sheets total: Includes 5 assorted-color pads with 20 sheets per pad. Each rectangular note measures 3 x 5 inches.
Full-adhesive design with a lifting edge: A wide adhesive area covers the back, with a non-stick edge to help separate one sheet from the pad.
Five colors shown: Lime, pink, orange, peach and yellow provide separate colors for subjects, tasks and reminders. The pack contains these five colors.
Write, lift and place: Start at the non-stick edge and separate one sheet gently. Apply to a clean, dry surface and test delicate finishes or printed pages before use.
Room for longer notes: Use the 3 x 5 inch paper sheets for checklists, study annotations, craft notes and everyday planning. Pens and other scene accessories are not included.
description: Keep longer reminders together with 4A full-adhesive sticky notes. This pack contains five 3 x 5 inch pads in lime, pink, orange, peach and yellow, with 20 sheets per pad and 100 sheets total. A wide adhesive area on the back and a non-stick lifting edge support everyday note taking and color coding. Test delicate surfaces and printed pages before applying. The pack includes paper note pads only.
